legend.PARTIAL: Real capability shipped with explicit boundaries
legend.MISSING: Not built; requires data or infrastructure that does not exist yet

capabilities.capability: Company research workspace (recorded evidence, financials, intel)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Generic news feeds do not bind every statement to provenance and availability timestamps.
capabilities.data_dependency: Recorded fixture archive per company (market CSV, financials JSON, intel JSON, sources JSON).
capabilities.pit_requirement: Every item filtered to available_at <= as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Every evidence record carries source_ids + provenance_ids.

capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Feeds ordered by timestamp/id determinism instead of engagement heuristics.

capabilities.capability: Advanced screener (numeric/string/boolean filters + has/missing presence checks)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Most retail screeners hide missing data as zeros; here 'missing' is an explicit first-class query.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Fields trace to financial records in the archive.

capabilities.capability: Evidence search 2.0 (AND terms, exact phrase, match tier labels, snippets, published/observation windows, historical mode)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Search results expose WHERE terms matched (title/text/metadata) as categorical labels, never opaque relevance scores.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Historical search returns only provably-knowable items (available_at <= as_of).
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Hits carry source_ids + provenance_ids + claim ids.

capabilities.capability: Research Change Radar (what changed between two as_of moments for a symbol or a saved screen)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Competitors show a static snapshot; none offer auditable diffs of the research record itself.
capabilities.data_dependency: Two recorded runs at distinct as_of timestamps.
capabilities.pit_requirement: baseline_as_of < current_as_of enforced; effective_at never exceeds current as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each change references source + provenance ids where applicable.

capabilities.capability: Evidence Delta (new/removed/changed evidence, conflict transitions, gap transitions, freshness changes)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: No competitor surfaces how the evidence base itself moved between dates.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Both sides computed at their own as_of.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Delta entries carry full lineage ids.

capabilities.capability: Research Context Snapshot (shareable rc-* context id replaying one exact recorded state)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Analysts cannot today share a link that deterministically reproduces one research state.
capabilities.data_dependency: Deterministic id derivation from symbol + as_of.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Replay re-runs the recorded service at the embedded as_of; tampered ids rejected via digest check.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Snapshot embeds PIT accounting identical to /research contract.

capabilities.capability: Conflict Explorer (both sides of conflicting evidence, no winner)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Competitors silently pick a narrative; this system names both sides and refuses to arbitrate.
capabilities.data_dependency: Conflict detection over intel items sharing a topic with opposing directions.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Conflicts evaluated at as_of only from known items.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Each side cites its own source and excerpt.

capabilities.capability: Coverage Delta (categories gained/lost, gaps opened/resolved between two contexts)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Coverage changes are invisible elsewhere; here they are first-class transitions.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Both sides at their own as_of.

capabilities.capability: Compare 2.0 (side-by-side facts incl. coverage, conflicts, freshness, gaps-by-status, PIT consistency note)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Comparisons state facts without ratings and disclose when columns were captured at different times.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Notes flag any column whose captured as_of differs.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Rows derive from recorded artifacts only.

capabilities.capability: Recorded-event calendar (RECORDED vs ANNOUNCED states, explicit non-guarantee)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Event calendars elsewhere imply certainty; announced items are labeled as non-guaranteed statements of intent.
capabilities.data_dependency: Timeline entries in the recorded intel archive (live calendar APIs intentionally NOT used).
capabilities.pit_requirement: Range filtering on event_date; ANNOUNCED = future-dated relative to as_of.

capabilities.capability: Export package v2 (research.json + screener_fields.csv + evidence.json + pit.json + sources.csv, sha256 manifest)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Exports are verifiable byte-for-byte and carry the PIT accounting block.
capabilities.data_dependency: All payloads already produced by engines.

capabilities.capability: Change timeline UI (visual timeline of research changes)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: API contract exists (/research-changes); frontend rendering is Terminal 2 scope.

capabilities.capability: Point-in-time replay sessions (browse any historical date interactively)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Context-id replay proves single-state reproducibility; multi-date session browsing is future work.
capabilities.data_dependency: Requires dense archives per date; current fixtures cover two reference dates.

capabilities.capability: Provenance chain drill-down (source -> acquisition -> transformation -> artifact)
capabilities.competitor_gap_closed: Source/provenance ids exposed everywhere; deep chain visualization pending frontend work.
capabilities.data_dependency: Raw archive records already tracked in git.

capabilities.capability: Research memory (persisted analyst notes bound to context ids)
capabilities.data_dependency: Requires user-scoped storage; no auth/user model exists yet.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Must store context_id, never mutable snapshots.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Notes must link back to replayable contexts.

capabilities.capability: Live market/news ingestion for change detection in production
capabilities.data_dependency: Requires production archiving pipeline; beta runs on committed fixtures.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Availability timestamps must be assigned at ingestion time.
capabilities.provenance_requirement: Raw records must land before derived artifacts.

capabilities.data_dependency: No real recorded datasets exist for these classes yet; faking them violates product rules.
capabilities.pit_requirement: Same standards apply when real data arrives.

capabilities.capability: Scores, rankings, buy/sell recommendations, price predictions
